1_cozy_meeting.dialogue: There you go! Hiii, I'm Gigi! I'd been watching you in your cell for a little while but then suddenly all these alarms started blaring and you fell right out of it! Oh, right, what's your name?
Ros. What's a... uh... gun as nice as you doing here?
I don't know... I just woke up here, same as you. I really don't like this place, it was so terrifying being alone in here before you woke up.
But now that you're awake, maybe we can work together to get out of here? I'm pretty good at shooting things, and you look really strong, I'm sure the climb out won't be a problem for you at all.
So whaddya say? Wanna team up with me?
Of course! Don't worry about a thing, I'll protect you and get us both out of here together.

2_cozy_interlude.dialogue: These convict guys we've been fighting have been pretty crazy, huh?
They're the results of some experiments done on them elsewhere in the prison. They've all been infected with something and now they've totally lost their minds.
As long as you've got me though, you'll be safe from that. You've been doing a really good job of keeping me safe, too! We make such a great team.
Yeah, for sure. I'm really surprised by how well you've been handling all this.
I mean... I am [i]literally[/i] a gun.
Haha hey, no need to get all defensive. You're doing great.

3_punk_meeting.dialogue: Hello [i]prisoner[/i]. What the hell are you bothering me for? I don't have much time for a thing like you, I'm busy. Whatever it is you want, spit it out.
Uh, sorry for bothering you, miss. Myself and Gigi here are trying to get out of this place and thought you looked helpful. If you don't want to, I'll just go.
Huh, you've not lost your mind like the others... yet. I see you've managed to get your hands on another one of us guns, too.
Fine. I'm Gigi. For the sake of making things a little easier for you, I'll allow you to call me Punk Gigi. You can also call the other one Cozy Gigi, if she didn't tell you that already.
Uh, yeah, that's totally fine with me! Also his name is Ros, by the way.
Uh, Great. Well, Ros, you're going to bring me with you now, so we can both get out of here. We both know I'll be a lot more useful to you than that little pistol.
Hey! I've been doing really good! Why are you being so mean to me?!
Hey, Cozy, she didn't mean it. Don't cause a fight— we all need to be able to get along so we can get out of here.
Punk, we'd be glad to have you along.

4_punk_cozy_interlude.dialogue: This is ridiculous. How are you taking this long to get us out of here? All you have to do is run and climb!
We've been in this ONE ROOM for like 3 hours and we're only halfway. We can't move by ourselves y'know, we need you to carry us out of here, so stop wasting my time.
Um, sorry. It's okay Ros. I think you're doing a really good job and I trust that you'll get us both to the top as quickly as you can.
Thanks Cozy. I'm going as fast as I can.
I'll be fine as long as the two of you don't jam on me.
I won't let you down, Ros! You just keep climbing and I can handle the shooting, okay?
Of course I won't jam. I can[i]not[/i] believe you'd even suggest that.

5_soldier_meeting.dialogue: Can I help you with something?
Myself and these two girls are getting out of here. Do you wanna come with us? A sniper could definitely be useful.
Whatever. Sorry I asked. Best of luck to you three.
That's okay, I'm sure we'll do fine without you if you don't wanna get out of here.
Do you really think you can trust those two? What makes you so sure they won't stab you in the back the second you get past the door?
Because Ros trusts us! Not everyone is so cold-hearted that they'd just use a person like that.
You should try letting yourself trust someone for once, Soldier.
That's how you get killed. Anyway. Ros. I would like to leave this place, and you seem to lack any good long-range capabilities.
I do not particularly care about any of you, but teaming up to get out of here would be in our mutual best interest. Do we have a deal?
Haha, sure, I'll bring you along. I knew you were lying about not wanting to come with me.

6_all_3_interlude.dialogue: So, Soldier, what's your problem exactly? What're you calling me untrustworthy for?
We all want our freedom and I'm sure we'd all do or say whatever it would take to get it. I don't trust any of you but I'm happy enough to co-operate.

You really think you're better than me for acting like you don't care about anyone? Your whole no emotions charade is so laughably see-through. Hell, I'd say you're the one being dishonest here, having such a front.
So, You just keep on pretending nothing phases you and you don't care about anything until someone believes you and you suddenly walk it back. You are the WORST.
... All this because I called you out?
GUYS!! Please stop fighting!! We all need to be able to work together if we wanna get out of here. You're going to upset Ros if you keep yelling at each other.
I don't really mind if you argue, so long as it doesn't get in the way of me getting you all out of here. I'm the one doing everything here, so do try not to distract me.

7_brainjar_door.dialogue: Ahaha! Good work Ros! Incredible work! You did far better than expected! Now, just leave those little toys of yours by the door and you can get back to life as usual!
... in his prison cell?
Well, what other choice does he have, my beloved?
... Not doing that?
Ha! Very funny Ros! You must be a fucking hoot at parties.
But that's not an option, Ros. At least, not one you'll live through.
Oh, really?
What will you do if I don't hand my guns over?
I'll have your worthless little life snuffed out by the hundred other prisoners. Don't go thinking you're special just because I've allowed you to hold on to my precious Gigis.
You didn't allow him to do shit!
Quite the cont-
And we've been stomping out the other prisoners handily.
Well, that's because-
In fact, what's stopping us from breaking this door down and kicking your ass?
Well, sweetness, I promise you that your poor Ros will die if he tries.
In fact, what's stopping us from breaking this door down and kicking your ass?
I'm sure Ros can beat you! You'll hardly be a challenge to him, right Ros?
I don't need you to defend me.
Oh, sorry, I was just-
Shut up, Gigi.
Ah, look at you go Mr. Machismo!
Shut up.
What, is your fragile little ego cracking?
Shut. Up.
Hahaha! Look at you squirming when you're not the biggest voice in the room.
Pathetically clinging to my darlings just because you can walk all over them.
Now, drop them at the door and be the spineless little coward I know you are.
I'm gonna kick your fucking ass.
Ha! Your funeral, prisoner.

b1_prefight.dialogue: Ohhh, what a shame... I really did think you'd be capable of listening to reason, prisoner.
You just [i]have[/i] to go and make things more difficult, don't you?
Well, I suppose it makes no difference to me in the end. Thank you for bringing me my darlings, prisoner.
If you hand over the guns I'll make it quick. I know you struggle to handle it when things don't go your way, little prisoner, but this really is the best option for you, I promise.
Just fuck off with this and open the exit door before I blast a hole clean through your jar. I don't feel like playing games.
[i]Someone's[/i] a little high-strung it seems. Did my jokes from earlier really get to you that badly?
I am so sorry for making you feel like that, prisoner. I didn't realise you'd feel quite so insecure about meeting someone you can't just walk all over. That must have been really hard for you.
SHUT. UP. I AM NOT GOING TO LISTEN TO THIS.

b2_shieldsdown.dialogue: Very clever, prisoner. You figured out how to press some glowing buttons and disable my shield.
Do you feel strong? Do you feel powerful?
Go ahead. Shoot me. See what happens.

b3_damagetaken.dialogue: HAHAHA! YOU SEE? NOTHING YOU CAN DO CAN HURT ME, PRISONER.
Give up. Stop pretending you care so much about your little toys.
Just put my darlings in here whenever they stop stroking your ego.

b4_suggestsacrifice.dialogue: Well, what the hell are we supposed to do now, Ros? Are you really going to get me killed by being so incompetent that you can't even kill a floating brain?
Maybe we just didn't shoot him hard enough? We weren't ready that time, we can just try again!
No, his regenerative capabilities are too strong. It wouldn't work. Nothing from the outside would work.
On the inside though? His mind is a mess. If he came into contact with one of us, it would break him. Ros would just have to put one of us in that chute while his shields are down.
You literally cannot be serious. Are you crazy? I knew we couldn't trust you. We came all this way, I will not let you jeopardise our one chance at freedom.
It's this or we all die.
Ros, honey, I know you wouldn't do that to us. What's your idea to get us out of this? I know you must have one, you're really smart!

b5_kill_cozy.dialogue: Cozy Gigi. I'm giving you up.
We've been together longer than anyone! Don't you care about me? I've been nothing but kind to you this whole time!
I'm sorry Gigi, it just has to be like this.
You promised you'd protect me, Ros! You PROMISED! How could you?!
I thought what we had was special! I don't just want to get out of here, Ros, I want to get out of here with you.
It's just not going to work. It's not you, Gigi, it's me. I just don't really feel much for you anymore.
Wha- I- I cared about you Ros...
I guess I just didn't feel the same about you. I've really made up my mind, no amount of crying will fix it.
I just wanted to be happy. I wanted to make you happy.
Yeah yeah okay whatever. This conversation is over. I decided I'm done with you.
...Fine. I'll take my chances with the brain. He can't be worse than you.

b5_kill_punk.dialogue: Punk Gigi. I don't need you.
HAH! Yeah, no. You do need me. You wouldn't last a second without me in this room.
You're so full of yourself. You're just not that important, Gigi. If I needed you I would keep you.
I fucking DRAGGED you all the way up here and you think I'm useless? After I mowed down hordes of enemies to protect you? You are so lucky that I'm the forgiving type, Ros.
I really ought to just refuse to fire right now and let you see what happens without me, but I'm going to be the bigger person. You have one chance to say sorry.
I am not changing my mind. You are not worth it. You're less important than the others, and you're certainly not worth me risking my life any further over.
You are not putting me in that chute, Ros. It's a funny idea to think that you're in charge of me, but we know you're not.
I hold the power here. You are WORTHLESS without me.
Big words from a gun who can't even fire herself.
I should have known you were too dumb to understand your place. You don't even deserve to be near me. Put me in the chute if you must, just get away from me.

b5_kill_soldier.dialogue: Disappointing. I thought you were smarter than this. You'll still need someone to blast a hole in that brain once his mind is fried. Can you be sure anything other than a railgun could do it?
I'll be fine. I'll get in there and tear him apart with my hands if I have to. He won't last long.
Fine. You can't trust anyone other than me, though. We have a deal for mutual interest. I need you to get out of here, and you need me to survive that process.
You have no such deal with the others. You're betting that they care enough about you not to backstab you the first chance they get.
I've just connected with them more. You're really cold and don't seem very interested in me.
Why should that matter? That doesn't matter at all.
I found you interesting enough to come with you, didn't I? That's all the proof you need that you can trust me. I wouldn't go with just anyone.
You're just kinda boring, sorry. It's nothing personal, I just don't really think we click very well is all.
You don't need clicking, Ros. You need someone you can trust to get you out of here. I promise you anyone other than me would gleefully stab you in the back at their earliest convenience.
I trust them. It will be okay. We're not all as paranoid as you are, y'know?
I see. Well. I guess I fucked up by assuming you had your own best interests in mind.
Remember this conversation when things don't work out for you. If I ever see you again, I will gladly kill you myself.

b6_first_sacrifice_given.dialogue: I knew you didn't have a single drop of care in your heart for these girls, Ros. Did it feel good to be mean to them?
Of course I care. I just did what I had to. No good getting upset over it.
Oh of course! I bet you feel like a real man for dumping a girl without feeling anything.
Well, I won't need to worry about that, anyway. My darling here won't be going [i]anywhere[/i].
I cannot wait to kill you.

b7_second_sacrifice_given.dialogue: HHHAAAAHAHAAAAA! MMMY GIRLS! MY GGGIIIRLS! GIGIIIIII!
They're so perfect. Did you know that Ros? That they're perfect? PERFECT.
Go ahead, Ros. Kill me. See what happens. Hahaha.
Of coI think you'll start to see the girl you've held onto in a very different light.

b8_death.dialogue: MMMMINE. MINE. MINE. THEY'RE MMMINE. MMINNE. MINE.
